name: cossack squats
description: A wide side-to-side squat where you sink onto one leg while the other stays straight. It builds leg strength and hip mobility.
instructions: Stand with your feet much wider than shoulder width and toes slightly out.
Shift your weight to one side and bend that knee, sitting your hips down and back.
Keep the other leg straight with the heel down and toes up.
Push through the bent leg to slide back to the centre.
Repeat on the other side and keep your chest tall.
